name: Brainrot
metaDescription: Brainrot sound buttons — 67, Italian brainrot, Tung Tung Sahur, Tralalero Tralala, sigma and skibidi sounds. Play instantly, download free.
intro:
Welcome to the brainrot soundboard: the sounds that colonised Gen Alpha's vocabulary and made every teacher's job harder. This is where 67, the Italian brainrot creatures, sigma anthems and skibidi-adjacent chaos all live together, exactly as nature intended.

Brainrot isn't really a genre — it's what happens when meme velocity outruns meaning. A shark in trainers gets a theme song, two numbers become a chant, and a fourteen-second song about lava chicken charts internationally. Every button here plays instantly and downloads free, so you can bring the chaos to your own edits, Discord calls, and classrooms.

faq.a: Honestly, nothing specific — that's the joke. It came from Skrilla's track 'Doot Doot (6 7)' and spread through basketball edits into a call-and-response chant with hand gestures. Kids say it because other kids say it, which is the purest form of brainrot.

A wave of AI-generated characters with absurd Italian-sounding names and voiceovers — Tralalero Tralala, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, and dozens more. It started as nonsense and became one of the biggest meme movements of the decade.

faq.q: Are these brainrot sounds free to download?
faq.a: Yes — every sound has a free MP3 download on its page, ready for edits, Discord soundboards, or stream alerts.
